title: A Promise of Hope
content:
The rest of the day passed peacefully.

Sneha spent every moment with her mother.

Her mother prepared all of Sneha's favourite dishes for lunch, filling the house with delicious aromas.

She then smiled and said,

"Call your friends too."

"Let's celebrate together."

Sneha happily invited Yagnesh and her childhood friends.

Soon, the house echoed with laughter and cheerful conversations.

Everyone enjoyed the meal while teasing each other with old memories and funny stories.

Hours passed before anyone even realized it.

After lunch, while Sneha sat talking with her friends, Yagnesh and the others helped her mother clean the dining table and wash the dishes.

Her mother smiled warmly.

"You children have grown up so much."

Once everything was finished, everyone gathered in the living room and relaxed on the sofa, watching a movie together.

For a while...

The house was filled with nothing but laughter.

Then, during a quiet moment, Sneha's mother looked at her daughter and asked gently,

"Sneha..."

"When are you finally going to get married?"

The smile on Sneha's face slowly disappeared.

"Mom..."

"Please don't start this again."

Her mother sighed.

"I'm only worried about your future."

Within moments, the conversation turned into another argument.

Seeing both of them getting emotional, Yagnesh stepped forward.

"Aunty..."

"I think it's time you knew the truth."

Sneha immediately looked at him.

For a long moment...

She remained silent.

Finally, she nodded.

"Okay..."

Before she could say another word, her phone suddenly began to ring.

She looked at the screen.

Shreya Calling...

Sneha's heartbeat quickened.

She looked at Yagnesh.

"Please tell Mom everything."

"I need to take this call."

Yagnesh nodded.

"Don't worry."

"I'll explain."

Sneha hurried to her room and answered the call.

"Hello..."

"Shreya..."

"Thank God you called."

"I wasn't sure whether you'd remember me."

"And..."

"I'm really sorry for troubling you that day."

Shreya smiled softly from the other end.

"You don't have to apologize."

"I wasn't upset with you."

There was a brief pause.

Then she continued,

"And don't worry..."

"I've decided to help you."

"I'm going to make sure your love story reaches the ending it deserves."

Sneha stood frozen, her fingers tightening around the phone.

For the past five years...

She had learned to expect disappointment whenever hope appeared.

But today...

For the first time, someone else believed in the love she had refused to give up on.

Her eyes slowly filled with tears.

Not tears of sadness...

But tears of relief.

She took a deep breath, trying to steady her trembling voice.

"Shreya..."

"What do you mean...?"

"What happened after you met Siddu?"

"Please..."

"Tell me everything."

On the other end of the call...

Shreya remained silent for a few seconds.

She took a slow breath before finally speaking.

"It's a long story, Sneha..."

"But I will tell you everything."

Sneha held the phone tightly.

For five years...

She had waited for answers.

She had wondered what happened after Shreya met Siddu.

She had wondered whether Siddu still remembered her.

And now...

The person who knew the truth was finally ready to tell her.

"Shreya..."

"I'm listening."
